title: A scheme over a field covered by finitely many finite open pieces is finite, of degree at most the sum
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a morphism $t:T\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $T=W_1\cup\dots\cup W_m$ ($m\ge0$) be a covering of $T$ by finitely many open subschemes. Suppose that for each $i$ the scheme $W_i$, over $k$ through $t|_{W_i}$, is finite over $k$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] (so $W_i$ is affine and $\Gamma(W_i,\mathcal O_{W_i})$ is a finite-dimensional $k$-algebra) with $\dim_k\Gamma(W_i,\mathcal O_{W_i})\le n_i$ for an integer $n_i\ge0$. Then $T$ is finite over $k$ and $\dim_k\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)\le n_1+\dots+n_m$. (The step 'if $n_i$ works for $f|_{U_i}:U_i\to V_i$, then $\sum n_i$ works for $f$' of the proof of Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma Tag 03JA, applied to the fibre $T=X_y$ and its open covering by the fibres $(U_i)_y$.)

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma Tag 03JA (lemma-locally-quasi-finite-qc-source-universally-bounded), first paragraph, lines 15505-15518 (stated without proof there; compare the proofs of Lemma Tag 03J5, line 15322, and Tag 03J6, line 15371: a scheme over a field with finite discrete underlying space is affine and its ring is the product of its local rings)

proof.text: Put B_i = Γ(W_i, O), with its k-algebra structure induced by t_i. The Mathlib declarations realizing [lem-weil-pbc-finite-over-field-affine-finite-dim] give IsAffine W_i and finiteness of t_i.appTop. Precomposing with the inverse of ΓSpecIso k preserves finiteness, so Module.Finite k B_i. For the field k, its prime spectrum is discrete. Algebra.QuasiFinite.discreteTopology_primeSpectrum specializes the Mathlib leaf [lem-weil-pbc-finite-over-zero-dim-local-discrete-spectrum] to B_i; compactness of Spec B_i then gives finitely many points. Transport both properties along W_i.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph. In Lean these facts are established before constructing the global restriction map.

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma Tag 03J6 (lemma-composition-universally-bounded), line 15371 ff.: 'the underlying topological space of $Y_z$ is a finite discrete set' and 'Thus $X_z$ is an affine scheme' (the same argument, used here for $T$)

proof.text: The open-cover equation yields the set equation union_i W_i = T. Set.finite_iUnion applied to the finite underlying sets of step 1 gives Finite T. For x in T, choose a covering W_i containing x. Its singleton is open by discreteness of W_i, and its image under the open embedding W_i -> T is the singleton {x}; hence DiscreteTopology T. With the empty index set the cover equation forces T empty, and the same union argument applies.

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma Tag 03J6 (lemma-composition-universally-bounded), line 15371 ff.: 'the underlying topological space of $Y_z$ is a finite discrete set' and 'Thus $X_z$ is an affine scheme' (the same argument, used here for $T$)

proof.text: *$T$ is affine.* By step 2 and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-discrete-scheme-affine], $T$ is affine: with $A=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ the canonical morphism $T\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is an isomorphism. Make $A$ a $k$-algebra through the ring map $t^\sharp:k=\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}k,\mathcal O)\to A$ induced by $t$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum].

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma Tag 03J6 (lemma-composition-universally-bounded), line 15371 ff.: 'the underlying topological space of $Y_z$ is a finite discrete set' and 'Thus $X_z$ is an affine scheme' (the same argument, used here for $T$)

proof.text: Equip A = Γ(T,O) with t.ΓAlgebra and each B_i with t_i.ΓAlgebra. Define the algebra homomorphism rho_i using the ring homomorphism (W_i).ι.appTop. Its scalar compatibility is exactly Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop. LinearMap.pi packages these into a k-linear restriction map f : A -> product_i B_i. If f(a)=f(b), congrFun gives equality of restrictions on every W_i. Apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' to T.sheaf and the cover to conclude a=b. The product is a finite k-module by step 1, so Module.Finite.of_injective gives Module.Finite k A. LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective and Module.finrank_pi_fintype give dim_k A <= sum_i dim_k B_i <= sum_i n_i. Sheaf locality and the empty product also cover m=0.

proof.text: Apply the affine-target specialization of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-local-on-target], namely HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine with P = IsFinite. Its first requirement is IsAffine T from step 3. Its second is finiteness of t.appTop. RingHom.finite_algebraMap translates Module.Finite k A from step 4 into finiteness of ((ΓSpecIso k).inv >> t.appTop).hom. Cancel the ring isomorphism ΓSpecIso k on the left using RingHom.finite_respectsIso.cancel_left_isIso to obtain finiteness of t.appTop. Pair the resulting IsFinite t with the dimension estimate of step 4.

lean.statement: theorem finite_open_cover_degree_sum {k : Type u} [Field k] {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (m : ℕ) (U : Fin m → T.Opens) (n : Fin m → ℕ) (hcover : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) (hfinite : ∀ i : Fin m, IsFinite ((U i).ι ≫ t)) (hbound : ∀ i : Fin m, ((U i).ι ≫ t).finrankΓ ≤ n i) : IsFinite t ∧ t.finrankΓ ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, n i
